DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなことをお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事探しと住まい探しの相談があります。一度に話すと混ざってしまうので、今日はどちらから整理するか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事と住まいの相談が混ざるので今日の優先順を整理したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need advice about both finding work and finding housing. They get mixed up if I discuss them together, so I'd like help deciding which to organize first today.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that job and housing concerns get mixed together and you would like to set today's priorities. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれに期限がありますか。決まっていることから教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does each have a deadline? Please start with what has been decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今の部屋は来月末に出る予定です。仕事の応募はまだ締切を決めていません。住まいの条件を先にまとめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 部屋は来月末退去で応募締切は未定なので住まい条件を先にしたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I plan to leave my current room at the end of next month. I haven't set a deadline for job applications yet. I'd like to organize my housing requirements first.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you leave your room at the end of next month, the application deadline is undecided, and you want to address housing requirements first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 住まいについて、今決まっている条件と、まだ迷っている条件を分けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you separate the housing requirements you've decided from those you're still considering?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人で住むことは決まっています。場所は勤務先が決まってから考えたいので、駅を今一つに限定せず、家賃の上限を整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人暮らし確定だが勤務地未定で駅を絞らず家賃上限を整理すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've decided to live alone. I want to think about location after my workplace is decided, so rather than limit myself to one station now, I'll work out my maximum rent.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that living alone is decided but the workplace is not, so you will work out a rent limit without choosing one station yet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 希望をまとめた後、住まいの専門相談へつなげます。仕事の相談は不要になったということでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: After organizing your preferences, we'll refer you for specialist housing advice. Does that mean you no longer need job advice?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 不要ではありません。今日は転居期限と予算の相談を先にし、仕事の応募については別の相談時間を取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事相談を撤回せず今日は転居と予算を先にし応募は別時間を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I still need it. Today I'd like to discuss the moving deadline and budget first and arrange a separate consultation time for job applications.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep your request for job advice, prioritize moving and budget today, and ask for separate application advice time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。住まいの条件をこの欄に書き、仕事の相談も希望することを備考へ残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We'll write your housing requirements in this field and note that you also want job advice in the remarks.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 期限は来月末、一人暮らし、家賃上限は自分で確認中と書きます。駅は未定のままにして、仕事の相談が残ることも記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 期限一人暮らし予算確認中と駅未定を記録し仕事相談も残ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write end of next month for the deadline, living alone, and that I'm still checking my maximum rent. I'll leave the station undecided and record that job advice is still needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm recording the deadline, living alone, budget under review, station undecided, and the remaining job consultation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つを分け、今日は住まいの条件から進める相談で承りました。担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted that we'll separate the two and begin with housing requirements today. I'll direct you to the staff. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。携帯電話について何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with your mobile phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この電話を修理に出したいです。ただ、毎日の連絡と買物にも使っているので、預ける前に準備することを整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 修理預かり前に毎日の連絡と買物への影響を整理したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to send this phone for repair. But I use it daily for communication and shopping, so I'd like to organize what I need to prepare before leaving it with you.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to organize the effects on daily communication and shopping before handing over your phone for repair. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 修理の受付を進める前に確認しましょう。特に使えなくなると困るのは、どの機能ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check before proceeding with repair reception. Which functions would cause particular difficulty if unavailable?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 勤務先との連絡と買物の支払いです。予備の電話はありますが、同じアプリへ入れるかはまだ試していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務連絡と決済が必要で予備電話はあるがアプリ利用は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Contacting my workplace and paying for shopping. I have a spare phone, but haven't yet tried whether I can access the same apps on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you need work communication and payments and have a spare phone but have not confirmed app access. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の電話で使えるかは、アプリごとの条件確認が必要です。こちらで全てのアカウント移行を確約することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Whether you can use another phone depends on each app's conditions. We can't guarantee that all accounts can be transferred.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず勤務先へ別の連絡先を伝えます。買物は当面カードや現金を用意し、予備電話へ移せたことを前提にしないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務先へ別連絡先を伝え決済はカード現金を用意し移行完了を前提にしないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: First I'll give my workplace another way to contact me. For shopping, I'll prepare a card or cash for now rather than assume I've successfully moved everything to the spare phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will give work an alternative contact and prepare card or cash payments without assuming transfer is complete. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その準備が済んでから修理受付へ戻れます。今すぐ電話をお預かりするご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can return to repair reception once those preparations are done. Do you want us to take your phone now?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日はまだ預けません。家で必要な連絡先を控えてから、修理の預かり期間も含めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日は預けず家で必要連絡先を控え預かり期間も後で相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't leave it today. I'll note the contacts I need at home and then consult you, including about how long the repair will take.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not leave it today, will note necessary contacts at home, and will later ask about the repair period too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お戻りの際は、修理内容によってデータの扱いも確認してください。期間とデータの条件は受付担当がご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you return, please also check how data will be handled depending on the repair. The reception staff will explain the time and data conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡と支払いの代替を整え、必要な記録を残してから来ます。期間とデータの扱いを聞き、その後に預けるか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 代替連絡決済と記録を整え期間とデータ条件を聞いてから預けるか決めると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll arrange alternative communication and payments and keep the necessary records before coming back. I'll ask about the duration and data handling, then decide whether to hand it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will prepare alternatives and records and decide whether to leave the phone after hearing the duration and data conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日は準備事項の相談として承りました。まだお預かりは行いません。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted today's consultation about preparations. We won't take the phone yet. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。ご注文のお手伝いをしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. May I help you order?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で食べる予定ですが、連れの会議が延びています。私の分を先に作ってもらうか、二人そろってから頼むか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遅れる同行者と二人で食べる予定で自分の調理を先に始めるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two of us plan to eat, but my companion's meeting is running late. I'm unsure whether to have mine prepared first or wait until we're both here to order.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to start preparing your own meal while your dining companion is delayed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お連れ様の到着は、あとどのくらいでしょうか。お二人分はまだご注文いただいていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: How much longer until your companion arrives? Neither of you has ordered yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あと十五分くらいです。二人分ともまだ頼んでいません。連れの好みは聞いていないので、勝手に同じカレーを二つ頼むことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十五分後到着で二人とも未注文と本人の好み不明で二つ同じ物を勝手に頼まないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: About fifteen minutes. Neither of us has ordered. I haven't asked their preferences, so I won't order two of the same curry without checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your companion arrives in fifteen minutes, neither has ordered, and you won't order two identical dishes without knowing their preference. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。お客様の分だけ先に調理することも、到着後に別々に注文することもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. We can prepare only yours first, or you can order separately after your companion arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私は先に野菜カレーを一つお願いします。連れには今から自分の分を頼むと知らせ、来た時に本人がメニューを選ぶよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の野菜カレー一つを先に頼み同行者へ連絡し本人が到着後選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like one vegetable curry first. I'll tell my companion I'm ordering my own now and ask them to choose from the menu when they arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Order your one vegetable curry first and say that you will contact your companion and let them choose on arrival. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 野菜カレー一つですね。お連れ様が来る前に食べ始めてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: One vegetable curry, then. Is it all right for you to begin eating before your companion arrives?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、私の午後の用事が早いので先に食べます。連れと同時に食べ終えるよう、二人分を急いで出していただく必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 午後用事が早く自分は先に食べ二人同時の終了に合わせ急がせる必要なしと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, my afternoon commitment is earlier, so I'll eat first. There's no need to rush out both meals so that we finish eating at the same time.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will eat first because of your early afternoon commitment and don't need both meals rushed to finish together. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。お会計も先に一人分をお済ませになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I see. Would you also like to pay for your portion first?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の分は食べた後に払います。連れの分の支払い方は本人が着いてから決めるので、今は一人分だけお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の分は食後払い同行者の会計は到着後本人と決め今は一人分だけと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll pay for mine after eating. We'll decide how to pay for my companion's when they arrive, so for now please just handle one portion.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm paying for your own after eating and deciding your companion's payment with them on arrival, with only one portion for now. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 野菜カレー一つを先に調理します。同行者のご注文は到着後に伺います。ご注文ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll prepare one vegetable curry first. We'll take your companion's order after they arrive. Thank you for ordering.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。診察前にお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you before your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は一人で来ました。家に帰ると説明を思い出せないことがあるので、質問の紙に答えをメモしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人受診後に説明を忘れないよう質問紙へ答えを記録したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've come alone today. Sometimes I can't remember explanations once I'm home, so I'd like to note the answers on my question sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to record answers on your question sheet to remember explanations after attending alone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メモを取るご希望を担当へ伝えます。質問はすでに書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll tell the staff that you want to take notes. Have you already written your questions?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三つ書きました。ただ一行ずつ続けて書いたので、答えを入れる場所がありません。別の紙へ広く写したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三質問が連続一行で余白なしなので広く別紙へ写したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've written three. But they're written on consecutive lines with no space for answers. I'd like to copy them onto another sheet with more room.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your three questions have no spaces between their lines and you want to copy them onto a roomier sheet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 右側の記入台を使えます。質問を減らしたいのではなく、記録する場所を作るご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use the writing counter on the right. You want to make room for notes rather than reduce the questions, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、三つとも聞きたいです。それぞれの下に余白を空け、答えが長ければ要点だけ書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 質問を減らさず各下に余白を空け長い答えは要点を残すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I'd like to ask all three. I'll leave space below each one, and if an answer is long, I'll note just the key points.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep all questions, leave space under each, and record key points of long answers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 診察の時は、書くために少し待ってほしいと担当へお伝えください。分からない言葉も、その場で聞き直せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: During the consultation, please ask the staff to pause a little so you can write. You can also ask again about unfamiliar words there.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書くことに集中して分かったふりをせず、意味が分からない言葉は質問します。説明を全部録音する希望はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 分からない意味を聞き直し記録に集中して理解済みのふりをせず録音希望もないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rather than focus on writing and pretend I understand, I'll ask about words whose meaning I don't know. I don't want to audio-record the entire explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask about unclear meanings rather than pretend to understand while focused on notes, and that you do not want an audio recording. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望も伝えます。書いた内容が合っているかは、診察担当と確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass that on, too. Please check with the consultation staff whether your notes are correct.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三つの質問の下に答えを書き、最後に理解が合っているか確かめます。家族へ話す時も、自分が理解した範囲を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三回答の理解を担当と照合し家族へは理解した範囲を伝えると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write the answers below all three questions and check my understanding at the end. When telling my family, I'll also stick to what I've understood.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm checking your understanding of the three answers with the staff and telling family only what you understand. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 質問と記録の余白を用意するご希望で承りました。診察では担当とご確認ください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted your wish to prepare questions and space for notes. Please confirm them with the staff during the consultation. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。教室についてお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with the class?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この運動教室は初めてです。周りと同じ速さで動くより、まず基本の動きを見て覚えたいのですが、参加方法を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初参加教室で速さを合わせるより基本動作を見て覚える参加方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is my first time in this exercise class. Rather than try to move as fast as everyone else, I'd first like to watch and learn the basic movements. Could we discuss how I can participate?
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to participate as a beginner by watching and learning basics rather than matching the speed of others. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当指導員へご希望を伝えます。すでに経験がある運動はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll tell the instructor what you'd like. Is there any exercise you already have experience with?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家で軽く体を動かす程度です。この教室の動きは知りません。後ろでまねを続けて分からない所を隠すより、最初に教えていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自宅運動程度で教室動作未経験と分からない所を隠してまねず先に聞く希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only light exercise at home. I don't know this class's movements. Rather than keep copying from the back and hide what I don't understand, I'd like to be shown at the beginning.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only exercise at home and don't know the class movements, and want to ask first rather than copy while hiding uncertainty. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 開始前に指導員へ声をかけられます。どのくらい前にいらっしゃれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can speak to the instructor before the class starts. How early can you come?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は開始の二十分前なので、今から相談できます。動きを見学するか、説明の後に参加するかは担当と決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 開始二十分前なので今相談し見学か説明後参加か担当と決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today it's twenty minutes before the start, so I can ask now. I'd like to decide with the instructor whether to observe or join after an explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you are twenty minutes early and will consult now to decide with the instructor between observing and joining after explanation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。分からなくなった場合も、自分で速さを上げて追い付こうとせず、担当へ知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. If you become unsure, tell the instructor rather than speeding up on your own to catch up.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、回数を多くこなすことだけを目標にせず、分かる動きを確認します。途中で相談したくなった時の合図も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 回数だけを目標にせず動作理解を確認し途中相談の合図も尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Rather than aim only for more repetitions, I'll check the movements I understand. I'd also like to ask how to signal if I want advice during the class.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check your understanding rather than focus only on repetitions and ask about a signal for advice mid-class. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合図と参加の範囲は指導員がご案内します。受付が一律の動作や回数を指定するものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The instructor will explain the signals and extent of participation. Reception doesn't prescribe the same movements or number of repetitions for everyone.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 指導員へ初参加と基本を見たい希望を伝え、合図も確認します。今日どこまで参加するかは説明を聞いて決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指導員へ初参加と基本の希望を伝え合図と説明後の参加範囲を決めると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell the instructor I'm new and want to see the basics, and check the signal too. I'll decide how much to join today after hearing the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will tell the instructor your beginner status and wish to see basics, check signals, and decide participation after explanation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 開始前の説明と参加方法の相談で承りました。指導員へご案内します。お声がけありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted your request for an explanation before class and advice on participation. I'll direct you to the instructor. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。面会について何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with visiting?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父に昔の写真を見せたいです。ただ、たくさん話して疲れさせたくないので、短い面会にする相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父へ昔写真を見せるが長く話し疲れさせず短い面会にする相談を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to show my father old photos. But I don't want to tire him by talking too much, so I'd like to discuss keeping the visit short.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a short visit to show your father old photos without tiring him through prolonged conversation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 職員へご希望を伝えます。今日は何枚くらいお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll tell the staff your wishes. About how many photos have you brought today?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十枚ありますが、全部見せるつもりではありません。最初は家族旅行の二枚だけにして、父が話したいことを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十枚持参だが旅行二枚から父が話したいことを聞くと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ten, but I don't intend to show them all. I'd like to start with just two from a family trip and listen to whatever my father wants to talk about.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you brought ten photos but will begin with two trip photos and listen to what your father wants to say. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人の様子については面会担当とも確認しましょう。写真の説明を続けるより、間を取ることも考えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's also check his condition with the visiting staff. Have you thought about leaving pauses rather than continuing to describe the photos?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、私の思い出を次々話すより、父の話を待ちます。返事が少なくても、思い出せないと決めつけて答えを急がせません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の思い出を続けず父を待ち反応少なくても記憶不可と決め急がせないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than tell one memory after another myself, I'll wait for my father to speak. Even if he responds little, I won't assume he can't remember or rush him for an answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for your father rather than keep sharing your memories, and won't assume memory loss or rush him if he responds little. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 面会の途中で気になる様子があれば、職員へ知らせてください。次の写真を見るかはその場でご相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you notice anything concerning during the visit, please tell the staff. You can discuss whether to look at the next photo at the time.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 無理に十枚へ進めず、疲れているように感じたら職員へ聞きます。今日は写真を見せ終えることを目標にしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十枚見せ終わる目標にせず疲れの懸念は職員へ相談すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't push on through all ten. If he seems tired, I'll ask the staff. My goal today isn't to finish showing all the photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that finishing all ten photos is not the goal and that you will consult staff about concerns over tiredness. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。持参した写真を置いて帰るご希望もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Would you also like to leave any of the photos here?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は全部持ち帰ります。父がまた見たいと言った場合は、残してよい物と保管方法を別に相談します。まず二枚で面会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は全写真を持帰り残したい場合は保管を別相談しまず二枚で面会すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take them all home today. If my father says he wants to see them again, I'll ask separately which ones I may leave and how they'll be stored. I'll start the visit with two.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm taking all photos home today, separately discussing storage if leaving any, and beginning the visit with two. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二枚から短く話し、ご本人の反応と職員への確認を大切にする面会で承りました。担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted a short conversation beginning with two photos, paying attention to his responses and checking with staff. I'll show you to the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like advice about today?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場で集めた募金を送る担当になりました。自分の貯金を入れる用事もあるので、二つを混ぜずに手続きを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場募金送付と自分の貯金入金があり二つを混ぜず相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've been put in charge of sending donations collected at work. I also need to deposit my own savings, so I'd like to discuss the procedures without mixing the two.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you need to send workplace donations and deposit your own savings and want advice keeping the two separate. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 募金のお金と、ご自身のお金は、今別々にされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are the donations and your own money currently separate?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、募金は封筒、自分のお金は財布に入っています。募金の金額は担当二人で数えた記録もあり、私の残高として考えないようにしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 募金封筒と自分の財布を分け募金額は二担当の集計記録があり自分残高と考えないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the donations are in an envelope and my money is in my wallet. Two people in charge counted the donations and made a record, and I'm careful not to treat it as my own balance.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that donation money is in an envelope, yours in your wallet, and two staff have recorded the donation total, which you do not treat as your balance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入金する先と名義は、それぞれ分かりますか。募金の送付について職場から案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you know the destination account and name for each? Have you received workplace instructions for sending the donations?

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 募金の送付先はこの案内にあります。私個人からの寄付と名前を変えず、職場の案内どおりにできるか担当へ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内の募金送付先を示し個人寄付名義へ変えず職場案内で可能か担当確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The donation destination is in these instructions. I'd like to check with the staff whether it can be done as my workplace instructs, without changing it to a donation in my personal name.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the donation destination instructions and ask staff whether they can follow the workplace instructions without changing it to a personal donation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内と金額の記録を担当へ見せてください。この受付だけで送付方法を確約することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show the instructions and amount record to the staff. This reception desk alone cannot guarantee the transfer method.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認が終わるまで募金を自分の口座へ入れません。自分の貯金の入金は別の用件として、必要なら順番を分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認前に募金を自口座へ入れず自分の貯金入金は別件で順を分けると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't put the donations into my own account before checking. I'll treat depositing my own savings as a separate matter and separate the sequence if needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you won't deposit donations into your account before checking and will treat your own savings deposit as a separate procedure. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どちらを先に相談するか、ご希望はありますか。封筒をこちらへ置いたまま離れず、お手元で管理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Which would you like to discuss first? Please keep the envelope with you rather than leave it here unattended.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に募金の案内を担当と確認します。封筒と記録は自分で持ち、自分の貯金と別の手続きとして説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 募金案内を先に担当と確認し封筒記録を自己管理して個人入金と区別すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the donation instructions with the staff first. I'll keep the envelope and record with me and explain it as a procedure separate from my own savings.
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm checking the donation instructions first, keeping the envelope and record yourself, and distinguishing it from your personal deposit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 募金の送付条件の確認を先に、ご本人の入金は別件として承りました。担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-IBR-TSUKUBA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted that we'll check the donation transfer conditions first and handle your own deposit separately. I'll direct you to the staff. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 回数券をご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you using a multi-visit ticket booklet?

DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。切り離した分も混じっていて、残りが分からなくなりました。
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 回数券の残数不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Some detached tickets are mixed in, and I've lost track of how many I have left.
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you don't know the number of tickets remaining. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 冊子と切り離した券を見せてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the booklet and detached tickets.

DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。使った券の控えも一枚あります。
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 冊子と控えの混在を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. There's also one stub from a ticket I've used.
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the booklet and a used-ticket stub are mixed together. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用できる券と控えは別に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check usable tickets and stubs separately.

DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 控えを脇へ置いて、有効な券だけ一緒に数えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 控えを除き有効券の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll set the stub aside. Please count just the valid tickets with me.
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Set aside the stub and ask to check the valid tickets. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できた券のうち、今日は何枚使いますか。
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of the tickets we've checked, how many will you use today?

DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私一人なので一枚です。残りはまとめて保管します。
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日の使用枚数を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-08.translation: One, because it's just me. I'll store the rest together.
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify how many tickets you will use today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受け取る一枚はこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is this the one ticket you'd like me to take?

DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。その一枚だけ使います。残りを冊子と同じ袋へしまいました。
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一枚だけ渡し残りを保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll use only that one. I've put the rest in the same bag as the booklet.
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over only one ticket and store the rest. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、一枚を受け取り、本日の受付を進めます。
DLG-SC-ISK-KAGA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll take one ticket and proceed with today's admission.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作品の印はこちらで合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this the correct identifying mark on your piece?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも、この印は正面を示すものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 識別印と正面の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But that mark doesn't indicate the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the identifying mark and the front. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 展示するときの正面はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which side should face forward when it is displayed?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: くぼみのある側です。印だけで判断されないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正面の特徴と誤認の懸念を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The side with the indentation. I don't want the front to be judged by the mark alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the front's distinguishing feature and your concern about misidentification. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 依頼票に図を描けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can draw a diagram on the request form.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上から見た形を描いて、くぼみの位置に矢印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 依頼票へ向きを図示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll draw the shape as seen from above and put an arrow at the indentation.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Draw the orientation on the request form. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 印も図の中に入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please include the mark in the diagram, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 反対側に印を書きました。二つの位置が分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 印の位置も加えて照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've drawn the mark on the opposite side. Can you tell where both are?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Add the mark's position and check the diagram together. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かります。受け取りのときもこの図を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, I can. Let's check this diagram at collection, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 依頼票の控えを持ってきて、正面を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取時の確認資料を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll bring my copy of the request form and check which side is the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide which document to use for checking at collection. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、図を添えて焼成担当へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll attach the diagram and hand it to the firing staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れ様は後から到着されますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私は先に着きました。部屋の準備前なら荷物だけ預けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 先着と荷物預かりを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I've arrived first. If the room isn't ready, I'd like to leave just my luggage.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you arrived first and ask to leave your luggage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの一個でよろしいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。友人の荷物はまだありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 預ける荷物の数と所有を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My friend's luggage isn't here yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the number and ownership of the luggage you are leaving. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 夕食のご希望も二人分伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: May I also ask both of your dinner preferences?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の分は答えられますが、友人の希望は確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他者の希望を決められないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can answer for mine, but I haven't checked what my friend wants.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you cannot decide another person's preference. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、お連れ様の到着後に伺いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let's ask after your companion arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人には、到着したら受付で希望を伝えるよう連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 後着者への連絡を引き受ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell my friend to give their preference at reception when they arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Agree to contact the companion arriving later. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お戻りのときは、荷物の控えをお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show your luggage claim slip when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えを受け取りました。近くを散歩してから戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えを受け取り外出を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received the slip. I'll return after taking a walk nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the slip and say that you will go out. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご自身のお荷物一個をお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-KAGA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll hold one item of your own luggage.
